profile.name: 滨松 H11890 光子计数头
profile.description: H11890 是一类用于弱光检测的光子计数头，通常集成光电探测器、高压偏置与计数电子学，可对入射光产生的脉冲进行计数。它适用于荧光、发光、散射及其他低光强实验中的光子计数测量。
profile.description_en: The H11890 is a photon counting head for low-light measurements, typically integrating a photodetector, high-voltage bias supply, and counting electronics to count pulses generated by incident light. It is used for photon counting in fluorescence, luminescence, scattering, and other low-intensity optical experiments.

registry.name: Hamamatsu Photonics Hamamatsu H11890Device
registry.description: Hamamatsu H11890 Device是由Hamamatsu Photonics生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、初始化、启动、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, doShutdownDevice等操作。
